name: synthetic-realistic
note: Assumed shape of a long Claude Code or Codex working session. Every number here is inferred, not measured; lane 1's measuring proxy replaces it with per-request rows.

rollover.note: H4 supervisor rollover: when context reaches the threshold, the outgoing session writes a handoff and a fresh session starts from the head plus that handoff. All values inferred.

cvm.policy_note: strip_output_overhead 0.097 is the vendor's medium-effort figure for dropping thinking every turn (platform.claude.com preserved-thinking page); the effort level is inferred

head_note: Inferred. Head means everything fixed before the first user turn: system prompt, tool definitions, injected first-turn context. 42k matches lane 1's preliminary, unreviewed Claude Code default-mode request (not cited as measured).

anthropic.note: Opus 4.5 and later Opus, Haiku 5.5, and Fable 5.1 keep all prior turns' thinking in context and bill it as input

openai.note: reasoning items are not assumed to stay in Codex's resent input
